question: Will it make a difference, yes or no?

lines.text: Germany's Friedrich Merz has arrived in Kyiv with a billion euros in military aid, Reuters reports.
lines.note: Reuters via Moscow Times: Merz in Kyiv, 1 billion euros military aid, 4 Oct

lines.text: He came by train, as Kyiv sounded four air raid alerts on Sunday morning.
lines.note: Kyiv Post: special train; Reuters/Helsinki Times: four air raid alerts Sunday morning, sirens and explosions

lines.text: Russian drones hit Kyiv's Northern Bridge again. No casualties were reported there.
lines.note: Reuters/Helsinki Times: Northern Bridge struck, second day running, roadway and heating main damaged, no casualties from the bridge strike

lines.text: Merz brings one billion euros in military aid, plus 350 million for energy repairs.
lines.note: Reuters; Helsinki Times; dev.ua: EUR 1bn military, EUR 350m energy

lines.text: With him: minister Katharina Reiche and defence and energy bosses.
lines.note: Reuters; Kyiv Post: Reiche plus 10 executives; Siemens Energy, Hensoldt, Diehl Defence, Quantum Systems

lines.text: The two countries are finalising a joint drone deal, Reuters says.
lines.note: Reuters: joint drone production deal to be finalised

lines.text: It focuses on interceptors to catch Russia's jet-powered attack drones.
lines.note: Reuters: anti-jet drones, Strila interceptor, Quantum WIY Industries JV

lines.text: Overnight, Ukraine's air force says Russia launched 135 drones, 52 of them jet-powered.
lines.note: Ukrainian Air Force via Ukrinform 4 Oct: 135 UAVs incl. 52 jet-powered Shahed-type, 123 downed

scene.label: drones overnight, Ukraine's air force says

lines.text: They also plan joint weapons with a range of more than a thousand kilometres.
lines.note: Reuters: weapons with 1,000+ km range (dev.ua says 1,500 km drones; used the lower Reuters figure)

lines.text: Merz said Ukraine needs all our support in the coming weeks.

scene.quote: Ukraine needs all our support in the coming weeks

lines.text: And to President Zelensky: you can continue to count on our help.
lines.note: Reuters via Moscow Times; Kyiv Post, verbatim

scene.quote: You can continue to count on our help.

lines.text: Zelensky says Ukraine will double down on strikes on Russian oil refineries.
lines.note: Reuters: Zelensky, Ukraine will 'double down' on attacking Russian oil refineries

lines.text: A billion euros, under the sirens. Will it make a difference, yes or no?

caption: Friedrich Merz arrived in Kyiv by train as air raid sirens sounded, bringing one billion euros in German military aid and a joint drone deal, Reuters reports. Russian drones hit Kyiv's Northern Bridge again the same morning. Will it make a difference, yes or no?
notes_full: First reported 4 Oct 04:53 UTC (Reuters), then DW 05:45, Politico 06:22, FT 06:12, Kyiv Post 08:30 local, BBC 08:48, France 24, Le Monde, Al Arabiya; about 7 to 8h old at delivery
Merz 'war machine will turn against us' line deliberately not used (future-attack framing)
Sumy death and Dnipro injuries deliberately left out (no toll)
Kyiv Post's 1,000 interceptors figure not used (single outlet; TVP says thousands)
